main_body: raised wooden farm hut with tiled roof
top_band: tiled roof slope with ridge cap and yellow-cream highlight tiles through orange/red/purple tiles, rows 0-21
evidence: Reading down a middle column: rows 0-21 show the full sloping tiled roof from above (with a 2px ridge beam at rows 0-2 and patterned tiles down to row 21). Rows 22-23 show a dark eave overhang shadow over the inset front wall. Rows 24-34 show the wooden front wall with a recessed doorway and framed window, resting on a raised deck (rows 35-37) and stilts/ladder (rows 38-43).

style.evidence: The candidate uses the exact same Beodeul roof tile pattern and 6-step ramp (cream highlight, orange, rust, maroon, dark purple, dark brown border) and rich wood grain texture as the reference houses.
